test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Twenty people were buried alive when the building ________.
solution: The correct answer is '**collapsed**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**collapsed**'. • It means 'to fall down or break into pieces suddenly'. (अचानक ढह जाना या टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो जाना) • *Example: A lot of buildings **collapsed** in the earthquake.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Twenty people were buried alive when the building **collapsed**.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Damaged**: to spoil or harm something, for example by breaking it. [हानि पहुँचाना, नुक़सान करना (जैसे कुछ तोड़ देना)] • **Shook**: to move (somebody/something) from side to side or up and down with short, quick movements. [हिलना, हिलाना (इधर-उधर और ऊपर-नीचे जल्‍दी-जल्‍दी गति करना, करवाना)] • **Subsided**: to become calmer or quieter. (अधिक शांत या शिथिल हो जाना या मंद पड़ जाना) 3c:Ta54, The correct answer is '**advised**'.
